title: Special Topics in Persian Studies; Women in Islamic History, 600-1500
description:
Examines premodern women's history in the Middle East through a different theme each week. Students will learn about the diverse societies of Islamic history through readings, discussions, and individual research projects.

Crosslisted with HIST338D and RELS319L. Credit only granted for HIST338D, RELS319L, or PERS398Z.
